name: Kaai 4 Braai Restaurant

name: Delfino's Restaurant
description: Beachfront, family-friendly restaurant with breakfast, sea views, indoor/outdoor seating and a broad casual menu.

name: Blue Shed Coffee Roastery

name: Baruch's Coffee Roastery

name: Cafe Gannet

name: The Kingfisher Restaurant

name: Stars Restaurant & Sports Bar

name: Transkaroo Restaurant

name: The Merchant Coffee

name: Salty River Beerhouse

name: Bahia Bleu Restaurant

name: Peperboom Restaurant
description: A highly-rated daytime spot in the heart of Great Brak known for massive, delicious cakes, traditional breakfasts, and friendly small-town service.

name: Ponto Grille and Carvery

name: Vista e Mar

name: Carpe Diem

name: Cafe Havana
